CustomField.description: Formula to show SLA Status + Icon on ListViews and Standard Related Lists.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND ( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Case_Group", OR( TEXT( Type ) = "Confirmation of Payee Opt-Out", TEXT( Type ) = "Confirmation of Payee Opt-In" ) ), CASE( TEXT( SLA_Status__c ) , "Warning", IMAGE("/resource/copAlertIcons/alertWarning1.svg", "Warning", 26, 26), "Warning 2", IMAGE("/resource/copAlertIcons/alertWarning2.svg", "Warning 2", 26, 26), "Breached", IMAGE("/resource/copAlertIcons/alertViolation.svg", "Breached", 26, 26), TEXT(SLA_Status__c) ), CASE( RecordType.DeveloperName , "Confirmation_Of_Payee", CASE( TEXT( SLA_Status__c ) , "Warning", IMAGE("/resource/copAlertIcons/alertWarning1.svg", "Warning", 26, 26), "Warning 2", IMAGE("/resource/copAlertIcons/alertWarning2.svg", "Warning 2", 26, 26), "Breached", IMAGE("/resource/copAlertIcons/alertViolation.svg", "Breached", 26, 26), TEXT(SLA_Status__c) ), TEXT(SLA_Status__c) ) )
CustomField.label: SLA Status
